note: Recto body page, single column (text measure x 0.097-0.685), dominated by the Example 1.1 worked-example panel. Note the panel grey is #dbdcde - a LIGHTER grey than the #d1d2d4 of the running-header panel; they are two different fills and sampling the panel interior (not its edge) is what separates them. A2 splits the panel's prose into two `box` blocks, n=2 (the question and the Solution) and n=4 (the two closing paragraphs), with Fig. 1.5 (n=3) between them; both box elements therefore carry the panel's #dbdcde fill and their own vertical extent inside it. The panel is flanked by two solid cyan #00adef vertical bars: the plain left bar (x 0.098-0.112) is recorded as decorative_image, and the right bar (x 0.696-0.738) carries the box's label 'EXAMPLE 1.1' in white type set sideways, so it is recorded as major_heading - the same role given to the cyan title bar of the display box on p003. The outer margin holds a 'PHYSICS' roundel (decorative_image) above block n=5, a sideways-set marginal note whose URL is printed cyan #00adef. The panel's prose sets about 0.9x body size. No footer_rule on this page.
